name: Etched Tablet
summary: Etched Tablet is an introductory hunter quest delivered in the Valley of Trials after completing initial trials. It directs aspiring troll hunters to report to the hunter trainer Jen'shan to begin their formal training in the wilderness.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: After proving their early mettle against the local boars of the Den, novice hunters are intercepted by Gornek with a carved message. The stone tablet bears the mark of Jen'shan, a skilled troll huntswoman stationed nearby. Gornek passes it along as a sign that the young hunter has demonstrated sufficient grit to catch the eye of seasoned survivalists, marking the transition from basic brute survival to disciplined wilderness training.

sections.title: The Sharing of Survival
sections.body: When reporting to Jen'shan, the troll trainer speaks of the deep history between orcs and trolls within the Horde. While orcs possessed renowned traditions of warriors and shamans, the Darkspear trolls brought ancient stalking, tracking, and survival skills that helped the orcs endure life on Azeroth. Jen'shan views the training of new hunters as an ongoing exchange of survival knowledge, binding the allied races closer together through shared respect for the hunt.

faq.answer: The hunter trainer Jen'shan sends the inscribed stone, which is delivered directly by Gornek once you have proven yourself in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan is located in the northern area of the Valley of Trials in Durotar, positioned among the other class instructors near the Den.

faq.q: Why do troll trainers teach orc hunters here?
faq.answer: Jen'shan says the Horde turned to trolls for hunting lore while struggling to survive on Azeroth. The orcs already knew warrior and shaman ways, and both peoples continue exchanging their skills.

faq.q: What happens after turning in this tablet?
faq.answer: Jen'shan accepts you as her student, offering to instruct you in the fundamental techniques, shots, and survival practices required of Horde hunters as you gain experience.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before getting this tablet?
faq.answer: You must first complete the initial task Cutting Teeth for Gornek by slaying mottled boars to prove your basic endurance.

faq.q: Can any class complete this quest?
faq.answer: No, this quest is specifically for novice hunters starting their journey in the Valley of Trials. Other classes receive their own distinct training summons from Gornek.

angles.text: This quest marks your official entry into the ranks of Horde hunters, establishing your bond with the wilderness and your local trainer.
Jen'shan takes pride in how Darkspear hunting lore helped ground the Horde on Kalimdor, reaffirming the vital role troll traditions play in the survival of their allies.
For young orcs, receiving the tablet represents learning refined wilderness stalking and tracking from their Darkspear allies, supplementing traditional warrior might.
The exchange between Jen'shan and young recruits demonstrates how the Horde blends the distinct cultural strengths of orcs and trolls to ensure their mutual survival.
